scoped_blockers.summary: Architect AX now has a compact fixture manifest, but parity closure remains assigned to RADP-021.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Closed by RADP-020 compact manifest coverage for AX HTTP auth/account, HTTP market data, HTTP execution, WebSocket market data, and WebSocket order lifecycle fixture groups.

scoped_blockers.summary: Architect AX product support is AX perpetual futures, not a generic venue surface.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: AX parity evidence remains limited to AX perpetual-futures products and AX-specific instrument categories.

scoped_blockers.summary: Architect AX market-data support has explicit protocol limits.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: AX market data keeps L1 downgrade, unsupported index/close surfaces, bar-spec limits, and accepted book levels explicit.

scoped_blockers.summary: Architect AX execution supports a limited order and TIF matrix.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: AX execution remains limited to market, limit, and stop-limit flows, simulated market order pricing, and explicit GTD rejection.

scoped_blockers.summary: Architect AX auth/session and endpoint behavior need release-gate evidence.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: token auth, sandbox/production endpoints, public/private WebSocket paths, and cancel-on-disconnect remain fixture or dry-run validated.

scoped_blockers.summary: Optional Architect AX legacy bridge and extension surfaces remain until RREM-018 closed the scoped removal gate.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Deferred to the Rust-only removal gate because RADP-021 is superseded by RREM-018 removal authorization.
